description: This file contains a test suite for loading and validating an agent field package configuration from a YAML file. It creates temporary test configurations, loads them, and verifies various aspects of the parsing and validation logic.
external_files: <standard library and testing dependencies: os, filepath, testing>

methods.name: TestLoadAgentFieldPackageConfig
methods.description: Tests loading of a configuration file and verifies the parsed fields.

methods.name: TestValidateConfiguration
methods.description: Verifies the validation logic for configuration fields, including required, optional, value formats, and ranges.

methods.name: TestGetConfigurationWithDefaults
methods.description: Checks default value application when optional fields are missing.

methods.name: TestValidateFieldValue
methods.description: Tests the validation of individual field values against their validation rules.
